description_en: You can call the CreateDBResourcePool operation to create a resource group. This operation applies only to AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters of the new version in elastic mode
description_zh: 调用CreateDBResourcePool接口创建资源组。仅适用于AnalyticDB MySQL弹性模式集群版（新版）
kebab_example: aliyun adb create-db-resource-pool --db-cluster-id am-bp11q28kvl6880000 --pool-name test --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDBResourcePool

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL cluster.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters in a specific region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查询目标地域中所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the resource group.

The name can be up to 255 characters in length.

It must start with a digit, an uppercase letter, or a lowercase letter.

It can contain digits, uppercase letters, lowercase letters, hyphens (-), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
资源组名称。
长度不超过255个字符。
必须以数字、大写字母或小写字母开头。
可包含数字、大写字母、小写字母、中划线（-）和下划线（_）
parameters.name: pool_name

parameters.help_en:
The execution mode of the SQL query. Valid values:

batch: batch processing mode.

interactive (default): interactive mode.

For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189502.html
parameters.help_zh:
SQL查询的执行模式，取值说明：
batch：批处理模式。
interactive（默认值）：交互执行模式。
详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189502.html
parameters.name: query_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of nodes. The default value is 0.

A single node provides 16 cores and 64 GB of memory.

The total resources, calculated as (Number of nodes × 16 cores and 64 GB of memory), cannot exceed the total resources of the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
节点数量，默认节点数0。
1个节点的资源量为16核64 GB。
（节点数量*16核64 GB）的资源量不能超过集群总的资源量
parameters.name: node_num
